paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs in the EBS-AOS pattern. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{GM} [72, 77]), Tier-2 (OP_{GM} [64, 68]), and Tier-3 (OP_{GM} [34, 46]).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance (in percentage) of various large language models (LLMs) within the EBS-AOS pattern, as benchmarked for knowledge-grounded discussion summarization, with the caption noting that these results represent 0.90% of all evaluated LLMs; the models are stratified into three performance tiers based on their overall performance (OP_GM): Tier-1 includes models scoring between 72% and 77%, Tier-2 between 64% and 68%, and Tier-3 between 34% and 46%. The vertical y-axis is labeled “Overall Performance (%)” and ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 20, while the horizontal x-axis lists individual models without explicit labels, each represented by a distinct colored bar with its exact performance value displayed above it. The bars, arranged left to right, show values of 76.24 (teal), 73.94 (purple), 34.24 (light blue), 72.09 (maroon), 77.12 (light blue), 46.02 (tan), 76.71 (light blue), 67.58 (lavender), 63.63 (beige), 66.50 (light gray), 64.34 (off-white), and 67.55 (pale pink). Visually, the chart does not sort the models by performance but rather presents them in a fixed sequence, with Tier-1 models (76.24, 73.94, 72.09, 77.12, 76.71) occupying the higher end of the scale, Tier-2 models (67.58, 63.63, 66.50, 64.34, 67.55) clustered in the middle, and Tier-3 models (34.24, 46.02) at the lower end, with no explicit visual highlighting such as shading or borders to distinguish tiers beyond the numerical stratification provided in the caption.
